name: CUCKOLD'S GYM
source:
You'll find yourself at the center of Chris life, whose idyllic existence is shattered when he discovers his wife's betrayal in the gym.

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2757250/CUCKOLDS_GYM/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
你将深入克里斯的生活漩涡——当他在健身房撞破妻子的背叛时，原本宁静美满的日子瞬间支离破碎。

[摘自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2757250/CUCKOLDS_GYM/]Steam[/url]]
